name: text-tools
description: Counts words and reading time, and changes the case of text.
author: Jarvis examples
guide: word, character and sentence counts and reading time for a piece of text; changing text to UPPER, lower, Title, camelCase or snake_case

tools.name: text_stats
tools.description: Count the words, characters, sentences and paragraphs in a piece of text, with reading and speaking time. Use for "how many words is this", "how long to read". text: the text itself.

tools.name: change_case
tools.description: Rewrite text in another case. Use for "make this uppercase", "snake_case these", "title case this headline". text: the text. to: upper, lower, title, sentence, camel or snake.
